about.name: Alexandros Hatzopoulos
about.title: Founding Engineer @ OneOff
bio: Founding engineer at OneOff, building AI into a social fashion discovery and shopping app.
Before that, four years of DevOps at P1 Technologies: Kubernetes platforms, Terraform and cloud migrations for animation studios.
I like turning messy systems into repeatable ones and shipping tools that make teams (and now their agents) faster.

description: Founding engineer at OneOff, a social fashion discovery and shopping app where people curate shoppable edits, get AI-personalized recommendations and try pieces on virtually
Focus on AI integrations across the product: LLM and vision pipelines behind recommendations, product understanding and try-on
Work across the whole stack (API, web, iOS, admin tools, product ingestion) and the infrastructure, CI/CD and observability under it
Build the agent tooling the team ships with: multi-agent workflows, MCP servers and review automation
Led migration of Skydance Animation services to OCI, standing up OKE (Kubernetes) and standardizing infra with Terraform/Ansible/Packer
Cut deployment time 50%+ by replacing many K8s manifests with a single custom Helm chart (EKS) for Warner Brothers animation studio
Built monitoring + alerting platform (Grafana/Slack/Jira) with <5 min average response time to hardware issues for P1's Data Protection service (P1 Protect)
Sped up quote turnaround to customers by 90%+ by building an internal sizing tool for P1 Protect that automates vendor pricing aggregation and real-time calculations
Redesigned e-commerce front ends (CS-Cart) and improved UI/UX across multiple sites
Helped drive 110%+ e-shop sales growth through UX + e-commerce strategy improvements
Built an internal data access tool integrating with Oracle DB used by employees and B2B customers
Introduced/implemented modern frameworks (Laravel + Vue) into active projects
Built campaign front-end experiences with Vue.js and collaborated with remote stakeholders
